name: web
label: Web: pages read and searches made by this node, for work that needs the outside. Off until activated; every address is journaled

defaults._doc: This node, not the portal, makes the calls: activate it on the machine that should be the one touching the outside (a research node). search_url: the address of a search server you run that answers SearXNG's JSON API (/search?q=..&format=json); without one, searches are refused and pages can still be read. allow_private: false refuses every address that is not a public one (this machine, the local network, link-local), also after each redirect, so a page cannot steer a reader into the local network. allow_hosts: when not empty, only these hosts (and their subdomains) are read. block_hosts: never read. max_bytes: a page larger than this is cut. Outside contact: reading a page contacts that page's server; a search contacts your search server, which contacts the search engines it is set up for.

search_url.label: Search server address
search_url.hint: a SearXNG you run, e.g. http://host:8888; empty: no searching

allow_private.label: Allow local addresses
allow_private.hint: false: only public addresses are read

allow_hosts.label: Only these hosts
allow_hosts.hint: a list; empty: any public host
